title: Bitcoin’s $60,000 recovery masks a growing threat that could push its price as low as $29,000
summary: Bitcoin recovered above $60,000 after slipping below that mark on Nov. 25, in a volatile week in which Bitcoin fell to around $55,000, its lowest level since September 2024. BTC rebounded to $63,000 on Monday, but subsequently surrendered much of those gains.
